profile_text.body:
Richtech Robotics Inc. is recorded as a for-profit public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the ticker RR and SEC CIK 0001963685. The website associated with the record is rolls-royce.com, and the text drawn from that site describes Rolls-Royce rather than a robotics business. In that text, Rolls-Royce describes itself as pioneering technologies that deliver clean, safe and competitive solutions for power needs, and as developing complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land. It states that it has been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years.

The site material also lists several investments and partnerships. It reports a £300 million investment in UK manufacturing and engineering facilities for aerospace and defence growth, and a completed $1 Billion investment in Indiana. It announces a stated intent by Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce to partner on developing India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, and cooperation between Rolls-Royce, the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies.

The record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits and no MCP servers for the company. Nevada is the recorded jurisdiction for law exposure, with a count of zero cases. The name and aliases on file, Richtech Robotics Inc. and Richtech Robotics Inc-CL B, do not match the Rolls-Royce content on the associated website.
